lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_114.des: In the year 1988, 17-year-old delinquent Jotaro Kujo, grandson of Joseph Joestar, and son of Holy Kujo, is temporarily detained after beating up three armed men and a trained boxer. As Jotaro is now free to leave, Holy asks her son to come home, but despite her insistence, he refuses to leave his cell, claiming that he is possessed by an evil spirit. His prison mates confirm this bizarre claim, desperate to get out…
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_114.int: In the year 1988, 17-year-old delinquent Jotaro Kujo, grandson of Joseph Joestar, and son of Holy Kujo, is temporarily detained after beating up three armed men and a trained boxer.
As Jotaro is now free to leave, Holy asks her son to come home, but despite her insistence, he refuses to leave his cell, claiming that he is possessed by an evil spirit.
His prison mates confirm this bizarre claim, desperate to get out of the shared cell, seemingly fearing this 'evil demon'.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_114.out: The scene then shifts to near the Canary Islands in 1983, four years earlier, off the coast of Africa.
A group of treasure hunters uncover a heavy, 100-year-old coffin from the water, believing it to be a large treasure chest.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_115.des: A trio of treasure hunters have found a steel chest in the ocean and hauled it back to the surface. Assuming it contains treasure, they attempt to pry it open but are confused when it appears to be locked from the inside. They also briefly notice that the side of the box has the name "DIO" inscribed on it.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_115.int: A trio of treasure hunters have found a steel chest in the ocean and hauled it back to the surface.
Assuming it contains treasure, they attempt to pry it open but are confused when it appears to be locked from the inside.
They also briefly notice that the side of the box has the name "DIO" inscribed on it.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_115.out: Holy worries about what her father is doing to her son, while the guards are confused as to what's going on as they are unable to see neither the spirit nor its flames.
Having no other choice, Jotaro's spirit finally fully manifests to confront its threat.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_116.des: Despite not being able to see the spirits, the guards gape at the new, abnormally-high temperature of the room, caused by the flames of Magician's Red, unknown to them. Meanwhile, Jotaro's evil spirit can be seen fully for the first time and grabs Magician's Red by the neck. This causes an identical marking to appear on Avdol's own neck, implying that damage to someone's evil spirit reflects on its user.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_116.int: Despite not being able to see the spirits, the guards gape at the new, abnormally-high temperature of the room, caused by the flames of Magician's Red, unknown to them.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_116.out: With his new understandings of his "evil spirit", Jotaro no longer needs to quarantine himself, and instead inquires Joseph for how he knows of Stands.
The old man shows a picture of the previously shown steel chest that was lost for a century, a
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_117: 117. The Man with the Star Birthmark
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_117.des: Joseph explains that DIO is still alive, but Jotaro doesn't believe in such a story. To give proof of his existence, the old man takes a camera and activates his Stand, Hermit Purple. His Stand takes the form of purple thorns around his hand, which he uses to break the camera.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_117.int: Joseph explains that DIO is still alive, but Jotaro doesn't believe in such a story.
To give proof of his existence, the old man takes a camera and activates his Stand, Hermit Purple.
His Stand takes the form of purple thorns around his hand, which he uses to break the camera.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_117.out: He makes preparations to silence the Joestar lineage.
On his way to school, Jotaro is followed around by a group of schoolgirls and is then attacked by a mysterious young man.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_117.tra: Head out: The Man with the Star Birthmark
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_118.des: DIO recalls how he survived under the ocean and is determined to kill the Joestar Family, as they have acquired Stands just like him. To that end, he sends several Stand users to complete this task. One of these users attacks Jotaro on the stairs, which causes him to fall.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_118.int: DIO recalls how he survived under the ocean and is determined to kill the Joestar Family, as they have acquired Stands just like him.
To that end, he sends several Stand users to complete this task.
One of these users attacks Jotaro on the stairs, which causes him to fall.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_118.out: The young man says that he swore loyalty to DIO and was sent to prevent Jotaro and the others from discovering DIO's location.
To prevent the nurse from being harmed, Jotaro kisses her and uses his Stand to drag out Hierophant Green with its teeth from the nurse’s mouth.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_119.des: Jotaro's Stand successfully pulls out Kakyoin's Stand, Hierophant Green, from the nurse's mouth. It is a Stand made up of viscous, stringy matter. Kakyoin attacks with Emerald Splash, a technique where Hierophant Green shoots liquid energy in the form of sizable emeralds from its hands.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_119.int: Jotaro's Stand successfully pulls out Kakyoin's Stand, Hierophant Green, from the nurse's mouth.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_119.out: The infirmary and the floors above are devastated by the aftermath, and Kakyoin falls unconscious from his injuries.
Before anyone from the school can find out what happened, Jotaro picks up Kakyoin and leaves for home, intending to make him talk about DIO.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_120.des: While doing the laundry, Holy says that it feels like her son is nearby as if Jotaro is thinking about her at school. Just then, she is startled when Jotaro walks behind her with Kakyoin on his back. He asks where his grandfather is, and Holy says he's in the tea room.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_120.int: While doing the laundry, Holy says that it feels like her son is nearby as if Jotaro is thinking about her at school.

He asks where his grandfather is, and Holy says he's in the tea room.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_120.out: Jotaro manages to remove it in the nick of time and Joseph destroys it with his Ripple.
When Kakyoin regains consciousness and asks Jotaro why he risked his life for him, Jotaro says that he doesn't know why himself.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_121.des: While Joseph is waking up and Jotaro is about to go to school, Avdol finds Holy unconscious on the kitchen floor. He discovers that, just like Joseph and Jotaro, Holy has developed a Stand. As Holy is a kind and gentle soul without any fighting spirit, the Stand has turned against her, acting like a disease.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_121.int: While Joseph is waking up and Jotaro is about to go to school, Avdol finds Holy unconscious on the kitchen floor.
He discovers that, just like Joseph and Jotaro, Holy has developed a Stand.
As Holy is a kind and gentle soul without any fighting spirit, the Stand has turned against her, acting like a disease.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_121.out: When Jotaro asks him why, Kakyoin first answers that he doesn't know himself, then that it's only because Jotaro saved his life.
Avdol gives the name "Star Platinum" to Jotaro's Stand, according to the tarot card he pulled, the Star.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_121.tra: Head out: The Power Called a "Stand"
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_122.des: After realizing Holy's situation, Avdol says that if her Stand doesn't stop developing, she will die in fifty days. Holy says she's fine after taking medicine, but Joseph takes care of her by brushing her teeth, combing her hair, trimming her nails, and feeding her an apple. She starts to get up so that she can cook dinner for Jotaro, but he yells at her to stay in bed.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_122.out: Feeling threatened, Jotaro attacks it with Star Platinum.
However, the bug pierces Star Platinum's hand with a proboscis, heading for its mouth.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_123.des: Jotaro manages to block the enemy's attack with his teeth. Avdol recognizes the Stand as Tower of Gray, who is responsible for numerous slaughters disguised as accidents, such as a plane crash that killed 300 victims the year before. Tower of Gray moves away from the group and tears off four passengers' tongues by flying through their heads.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_123.out: While Tower of Gray is about to finish him, Hierophant Green uses the tentacles he had hidden under the seats to pierce through the bug-like Stand.
A bug-shaped wound appears on the Stand user's tongue, revealed to be the old man from earlier, then his head and tongue split in two.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_124.des: Gray Fly is defeated, but the group's plane suddenly begins to dive, and they confirm their suspicion by checking the cockpit and find out that the pilots have had their tongues ripped out by Tower of Gray. Gray Fly stands up and confronts the Joestar Group to spite them before dying and reveals that DIO controls many Stand users who will harass them throughout their journey. As the only one with a semblance of…

Gray Fly stands up and confronts the Joestar Group to spite them before dying and reveals that DIO controls many Stand users who will harass them throughout their journey.
As the only one with a semblance of experience in piloting planes, Joseph takes control of the plane and remarks that this is the third plane he will have crashed, to Jotaro's annoyance.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_124.out: Surprising everyone, a knight-like Stand attacks Joseph by stabbing his prosthetic hand; Avdol immediately counter attacks with Magician's Red's flames but the Stand's rapier easily deflects the flames on a nearby…
At the same time, the Frenchman reveals his Stand's name: Silver Chariot.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_125.des: In response to the French tourist's cockiness, Avdol destroys the table with the fire clock he made with just a swing of his hand and states that the fire he makes doesn't behave in the same way as other fire would. He asks the tourist his name. The tourist introduces himself as Jean Pierre Polnareff and proclaims that he will defeat Avdol in a place where Avdol can use his full power, suiting his Stand's victory…
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_125.int: In response to the French tourist's cockiness, Avdol destroys the table with the fire clock he made with just a swing of his hand and states that the fire he makes doesn't behave in the same way as other fire would.
He asks the tourist his name.

The tourist introduces himself as Jean Pierre Polnareff and proclaims that he will defeat Avdol in a place where Avdol can use his full power, suiting his Stand's victory represented by the Tarot Card, The Chariot.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_125.out: Avdol tells Polnareff not to underestimate his Stand and mocks him, saying that he is the one who will be defeated by his own Stand.
He tells Polnareff how foolish he was to predict something in front of a fortune teller.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_126.des: Jean Pierre Polnareff is hit by Magician's Red's Crossfire Hurricane and is seemingly defeated. Believing the fight to be over, the group starts discussing their journey. Silver Chariot suddenly reappears and takes off its armor, while the French Stand user jumps into the air from his position on the ground.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_126.out: Avdol recognizes that Polnareff is a man much better than DIO and finds a bud spore on his head, placed by DIO to control him.
He asks Jotaro to remove it.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_127.des: Jean Pierre Polnareff confronts Joseph Joestar about his hand, asking him if his left hand is actually a right hand. Confused by the unusual question, Joseph reveals it is a prosthetic hand, as he lost his real one in a battle a long time ago. Polnareff explains his question by telling the group how his sister was raped and killed by a man with two right hands.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_127.out: Jotaro grabs the kid and tries to drag him to shore, but accidentally touches his chest and discovers "he" is actually a girl, who calls him a pervert for grabbing her chest.
Meanwhile, the shark is cut in two by a mysterious aquatic creature.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_128.des: Joseph warns Jotaro that an underwater Stand is trying to ambush him in the water. Grabbing the girl, Jotaro is saved by Hierophant Green, who brings both back to the boat. The group suspects the girl of being a Stand user who was trying to lure Jotaro into the water to attack him.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_128.out: Jotaro asks Avdol to say something, and the fortune teller questions the imposter about predicting something in front of a fortune teller.
Polnareff completes the phrase by calling it a foolish attitude, mimicking Avdol and Polnareff's conversation in their earlier battle.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_128.tra: Head out: Dark Blue Moon, Part 2
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_129.des: The Imposter Captain Tennille is seemingly taken away by the sea while Jotaro tries to pull the runaway girl back to the boat. Jotaro begins to have trouble, as several barnacles are attached to Star Platinum's arm, sucking the Stand's strength away. Dark Blue Moon pulls Jotaro back into the water, but not before Kakyoin saves the girl.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_129.out: Star Platinum is now covered by barnacles that continue to drain his strength, so Jotaro focuses all his power into his fingers and uses Star Finger, extending two fingers into two of Dark Blue Moon's eyes.
Jotaro then rips off half of the Stand's head, claiming that the imposter will become sashimi.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_129.tra: Head out: Dark Blue Moon, Part 3
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_130.des: DIO has a conversation with Enya about what it means to survive. DIO believes that in order to survive, one must eventually end up on top. For this to happen to him, he needs to get rid of the Joestar Family.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_130.int: DIO has a conversation with Enya about what it means to survive.
DIO believes that in order to survive, one must eventually end up on top.
For this to happen to him, he needs to get rid of the Joestar Family.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_130.out: They decide to keep searching for the people who take care of it.
However, upon entering the deck of the ship, one of the crew members that was with Jotaro's group is suddenly impaled by a hook.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_131.des: Confused as to how many Stand users are present in the ship, the Joestar group splits up to look for any traces of a Stand. The sailors wait on the deck with the runaway girl. The girl approaches the orangutan Forever and seeing it communicate with gestures, offer her a cleanly cut apple and light a match to smoke, is surprised by its intelligence.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_131.out: After a short battle, Jotaro is suddenly hit by one of the ship's fans, which throws itself at Jotaro.
Confused, Jotaro wonders where Forever's Stand is hiding and why he can't see it.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_132.des: The battle between Jotaro Kujo and Forever continues. Jotaro wonders why everything around him is being used as a tool for battle, even though he cannot see Forever's Stand. Suddenly, Forever sinks into the wall to avoid one of Jotaro's attacks, confusing him even more.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_132.out: Jotaro uses this opportunity to have Star Platinum use Star Finger to propel the button Forever is holding into his skull and free himself as the injury cancelled Forever's control over his ship.
Forever surrenders, but Jotaro refuses to forgive him and pummels the orangutan with a barrage of punches from Star Platinum.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_133.des: After Forever's defeat, Big Daddy crumbles and sinks. The group, having boarded a lifeboat, wonders how an ape could have such a powerful Stand, which would have killed them if not for Jotaro. Joseph wonders if they will find more enemies as powerful as the orangutan.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_133.out: Devo still laughs maniacally after being hit by Polnareff and runs away, declaring that his Stand feeds on hatred and grows more powerful when Devo hates his target.
Polnareff's ankle is suddenly and mysteriously cut.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_134.des: Polnareff calls Joseph and Avdol's room, warning them about Devo the Cursed, but is unaware of the razor-wielding doll under his bed. After setting a meeting with his group, Polnareff then calls the hotel's room service for anti-inflammatory medicine and bandages for his ankle injury. Meanwhile, Avdol thinks Polnareff may have been tricked by Devo.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_134.out: It then saws the foot of the bed, which crushes Polnareff under its weight, but a man with medical supplies for Polnareff arrives and is quickly killed by the demonic doll.
Polnareff tries to fight with Silver Chariot but is unable to properly hit his enemy without his sight.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_135.des: Silver Chariot and Ebony Devil continue to fight. Polnareff thinks of a way to cut the cords tying him but is constantly being attacked by his opponent. Unable to see anything, Polnareff has Silver Chariot attack randomly in all directions, smashing mirrors around him, but this also proves ineffective.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_135.out: The group now wants to discuss how they will defeat Devo.
Seeing no one saw his injuries and that he already beat Devo, Polnareff calls everyone a "bunch of assholes" and falls unconscious from his injuries.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_136.des: Joseph reasons that if DIO is aware of his and Jotaro's actions because of having Jonathan's body, he can do the same to DIO. Avdol offers to get a camera, but Joseph says it isn't necessary, as he can use televisions as well. By rapidly changing channels with Hermit Purple, Joseph can sync up their speech to hear something he wants to know.

Kakyoin justifies his actions by saying the pickpocket was a bad man for stealing and needed to be punished.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_137.des: Kakyoin asks Jotaro why he's angry, as he just punished a criminal. He excuses himself for his impatience, explaining that he is tired because of the trip. Jotaro goes to buy tickets while Kakyoin stays behind with his coconut.

He excuses himself for his impatience, explaining that he is tired because of the trip.
Jotaro goes to buy tickets while Kakyoin stays behind with his coconut.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_137.out: Meanwhile, Anne calls Joseph and tells him what is happening.
Faced with the danger of being devoured by the Stand, Jotaro jumps out of the cable car.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_138.des: Jotaro uses Star Platinum to save himself from the fall. He wonders if he will need to cut one of his fingers to free himself from a piece of Yellow Temperance, and is taunted by Rubber Soul, who claims that it has no weaknesses. He tries to burn the piece, but it only expands it, so he borrows a popsicle from a boy in another cable car to freeze it.

He follows the words with an elbow to Rubber Soul's face.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_139.des: Rubber Soul begs for Jotaro to spare him. In exchange for this, Jotaro asks him about the other Stand users coming after the group, but Rubber Soul refuses to sell out his comrades and hurt his pride. Jotaro congratulates Rubber Soul for being a good and honorable man and prepares to beat him more, but the enemy quickly changes his mind and tells the four Tarot Cards the other Stand users represent: Death, The…

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_139.out: Bothered by how Rubber Soul did the same thing earlier, Jotaro remains silent.
In the background, Anne is shown sleeping on the train, having sneaked on to follow the group.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_140.des: The group is finally crossing India, albeit worriedly. India is known for having beggars, thieves, curry-eating and disease-ridden people. Avdol assures them that it is a nice country and that all these stories are false.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_140.int: The group is finally crossing India, albeit worriedly.
India is known for having beggars, thieves, curry-eating and disease-ridden people.
Avdol assures them that it is a nice country and that all these stories are false.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_140.out: As he washes his hands, Polnareff looks into the mirror and is surprised by a Stand with two right hands that he can only see in the mirror.
Determined to avenge his sister, killed by the user of this Stand, Polnareff breaks the mirror and searches for the Stand user among the crowd.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_140.tra: Head out: Emperor and Hanged Man, Part 1
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_141.des: Polnareff decides to separate from the group in order to find his sister's killer. Avdol tries to stop him, sure that separating Polnareff from them is part of a trap. Polnareff accuses him of being a coward for running away from DIO, and a fight almost starts between them.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_141.int: Polnareff decides to separate from the group in order to find his sister's killer.
Avdol tries to stop him, sure that separating Polnareff from them is part of a trap.
Polnareff accuses him of being a coward for running away from DIO, and a fight almost starts between them.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_141.out: Combining their Stands Emperor and Hanged Man, the duo completely mutilate the snake.
Later, as Polnareff searches for a lead, he sees the two Stand users slowly approaching him.

The numerous stabs J. Geil received from Silver Chariot also appear in her, making the woman cry even more, realizing he must have suffered before dying.

Joseph tries to cut it out himself with the doctor's scalpel, but the Stand grabs it with its teeth and manages to cut one of Joseph's prosthetic fingers.

Joseph decides to find the rest of the group, but Empress screams that he, Joseph Joestar, just killed the doctor and threatens the nurse. Thinking Joseph himself is saying this, the nurse calls the police, forcing him to flee.

He's scolded by Joseph for being a reckless driver, as they need to avoid attracting attention since Joseph is wanted for murder in the city of Benares.

The kid hits Steely Dan again, but is paid back with a punch to the face from an angry Steely Dan, who tells him he didn't pay to be hit twice.

Once it enters someone's brain, it creates a link between them and its user - if Steely Dan were struck by a car, hit by a baseball, or even trip on the ground, Joseph would feel the effects several times over.
He demonstrates this by cracking his knuckles, causing Joseph to feel a sudden pain on his artificial hand.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_162.out: When he doesn't respond, Steely Dan kicks his leg on a fire hydrant, hurting Joseph badly.
Steely Dan then enjoys the pleasure of a strong bridge he made of Jotaro, much to the latter's displeasure.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_163.des: As Silver Chariot and Hierophant Green travel in Joseph's blood vessels, Steely Dan commands Jotaro to scratch his back. Because of the link between him and Steely Dan, Joseph can't concentrate on his Stand and attracts people with his gesticulations, forcing them to buy the TV in order to move to a more isolated location. Finally, Polnareff and Kakyoin find Lovers in Joseph's brain.

Indeed, Kakyoin was able to find out which Lovers was the real one by using his tentacles to check every one of them, allowing Hierophant Green to hit Lovers with an Emerald Splash.

Afterward, Jotaro gives him "his receipt", and walks away.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_166.des: Having crossed the Gulf Straight from Karachi, the Joestar group safely arrive in the city of Abu Dhabi, though Kakyoin cannot shake the feeling that they are being followed, thanks in part to their encounters along the way and the "loss" of Avdol. Jotaro, naturally, voices his discomfort at flying in anything with Joseph (who has been in three aircraft crashes in his life), forcing Joseph to change their plans to crossing the desert on camelback, to Polnareff's…
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_166.out: As the heat slowly rises, Polnareff's comment about it rising to 50 degrees leads Joseph to check his watch, only to be stunned at the time (8:10), well past the time the sun should have started to set.

As if sensing their awareness, the temperature jumps to 60 Degrees Celsius, which, coupled by Polnareff noticing the "Sun" is rising from the west, to lead the group to deduce that the "Sun" is, in fact, an enemy Stand.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_167.des: The Joestar group is confused by this incredible Sun Stand. Joseph says that even in a sauna, staying more than half an hour is dangerous. As the Stand seems to be very powerful, raising the temperature above 70 °C, the user should be close by, but they can't see him.

He tells himself that he should be in Saudi Arabia crossing the desert, and looks over to see a dog sitting next to him. He then finds a balloon, which is carrying a card with a picture of a sinister looking clown with a scythe.

lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_171.int: After Kakyoin's previous outbursts, the group questions his sanity and wonder if he is still fit to continue the journey.
Joseph decides to cook some baby food over the fire, while the baby contemplates his plan to annihilate the group in their sleep.
Polnareff tries some of the baby food, and upon finding it delicious, tries to eat more of it to Joseph's dismay.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_171.out: The group agrees to figure out what to do with Kakyoin in the morning and all decide to go to sleep.
The Baby reveals that he had the scorpion inside his mouth the whole time and prepares to make his move.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_172.des: The group awaken in Death Thirteen's amusement park, questioning their sudden change in location. As Joseph realizes that Kakyoin has disappeared, Polnareff regains his memories regarding Death Thirteen and notifies the others that Kakyoin was right about the baby being a Stand user and enemy, warning them to not simply disregard the situation as a dream as he did before. Meanwhile, Mannish Boy taunts the group in…
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_172.int: The group awaken in Death Thirteen's amusement park, questioning their sudden change in location.

As Joseph realizes that Kakyoin has disappeared, Polnareff regains his memories regarding Death Thirteen and notifies the others that Kakyoin was right about the baby being a Stand user and enemy, warning them to not…
Meanwhile, Mannish Boy taunts the group in their sleep, saying how they won't be able to escape Death Thirteen's world with no one to wake them up.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_172.out: As a result, the others are freed, and they point towards Kakyoin who is sitting inside a nearby teacup ride.
He reveals that he summonmed Hierophant Green before being knocked out, and that he will punish Death Thirteen.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_173.des: Death Thirteen tries to attack Hierophant Green, but is unable to reach. The group apologizes to Kakyoin for not believing him, but Kakyoin thanks Polnareff for knocking him out. Thanks to that, he had his Stand active when he entered the dream.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_173.int: Death Thirteen tries to attack Hierophant Green, but is unable to reach.
The group apologizes to Kakyoin for not believing him, but Kakyoin thanks Polnareff for knocking him out.
Thanks to that, he had his Stand active when he entered the dream.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_173.out: Polnareff tickles the baby to get him to open his mouth, and Joseph feeds him the spoonful.
Kakyoin smiles and hums to himself, and Jotaro expressing confusion behind him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_174.des: The Joestar group begins to cross the Red Sea, the final stretch before Egypt. Jotaro says that they're heading in the wrong direction, and that the boat is going towards a small island. Joseph says that they need to meet someone there who is very important to their journey, but does not reveal who it is.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_174.int: The Joestar group begins to cross the Red Sea, the final stretch before Egypt.
Jotaro says that they're heading in the wrong direction, and that the boat is going towards a small island.
Joseph says that they need to meet someone there who is very important to their journey, but does not reveal who it is.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_174.out: Polnareff then stumbles upon a that washed up on the beach and rubs it, releasing a genie from it.
It asks Polnareff for his three wishes.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_175.des: After releasing the genie, Polnareff attacks him with Silver Chariot, believing it to be an enemy Stand. His attack does nothing, and he notes Cameo's power. Polnareff jokes that Cameo should make him rich to prove that he's a genie.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_175.int: After releasing the genie, Polnareff attacks him with Silver Chariot, believing it to be an enemy Stand.
His attack does nothing, and he notes Cameo's power.
Polnareff jokes that Cameo should make him rich to prove that he's a genie.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_175.out: When he gets closer, he hears a woman crying, and recognizes the voice as his sister, Chérie.
The group returns to their boat, wondering if Polnareff has been attacked by an enemy.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_176.des: As Polnareff walks through the tall grass, he spots a female figure in the distance. He asks the figure if it's who he thinks she is, but he loses sight of her when two birds fly upward in front of him. He chases after her, calling her name as Judgement lingers over him, watching.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_176.int: As Polnareff walks through the tall grass, he spots a female figure in the distance.
He asks the figure if it's who he thinks she is, but he loses sight of her when two birds fly upward in front of him.
He chases after her, calling her name as Judgement lingers over him, watching.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_176.out: He mocks Polnareff for his weakness and for his desire to bring the dead back to life.
Judgement also points out that Polnareff has already made his third wish, and reveals a fake Muhammad Avdol standing behind him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_177.des: The fake Avdol attacks Polnareff, knocking Polnareff back, but breaking off his fingers in the process. From the shock of being attacked by his dead loved ones, Polnareff hesitates in using Silver Chariot. When he finally reveals his Stand, Judgement appears and grabs it, holding down Polnareff as the "living dead" begin to gnaw on his flesh.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_177.int: The fake Avdol attacks Polnareff, knocking Polnareff back, but breaking off his fingers in the process.
From the shock of being attacked by his dead loved ones, Polnareff hesitates in using Silver Chariot.
When he finally reveals his Stand, Judgement appears and grabs it, holding down Polnareff as the "living dead" begin to gnaw on his flesh.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_177.out: To Cameo's surprise Avdol explains that when Hol Horse shot him, Emperor's bullet merely grazed his forehead rather than piercing his brain, knocking him unconscious rather than killing him.
Polnareff's third wish had came true.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_178.des: Avdol mocks Cameo about how he is still alive. This causes Judgement to retaliate stating he will kill both Polnareff and Avdol. Avdol summons Magician's Red to attack, but Judgement throws the fake Chérie at him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_178.int: Avdol mocks Cameo about how he is still alive.
This causes Judgement to retaliate stating he will kill both Polnareff and Avdol.
Avdol summons Magician's Red to attack, but Judgement throws the fake Chérie at him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_178.out: Cameo, rising from under the earth with a mouthful of piss, begs for forgiveness.
Avdol's fourth wish is to not grant any of Cameo's wishes and he burns him to a crisp.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_179.des: Polnareff enthusiastically rushes towards the group, excited to share the good news. He reveals to them that Avdol is alive! However the group acts completely nonchalant about it, as if Avdol had simply come back from a paid vacation.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_179.int: Polnareff enthusiastically rushes towards the group, excited to share the good news.
He reveals to them that Avdol is alive!
However the group acts completely nonchalant about it, as if Avdol had simply come back from a paid vacation.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_179.out: As Joseph picks up one of the cups it turns into an enemy Stand and cuts off Joseph's prosthetic hand.
Jotaro tries to punch it with Star Platinum, but the Stand flees and disguises itself as one of the submarine's many gauges.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_180.des: Within the submarine, the group cautiously stand away from the enemy Stand hiding among the submarine's gauges. Joseph remains unconscious from the Stand's attack. Avdol reveals that the Stand is High Priestess used by Midler, and is a long range Stand that can turn into anything as long as it's made of a mineral.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_180.int: Within the submarine, the group cautiously stand away from the enemy Stand hiding among the submarine's gauges.
Joseph remains unconscious from the Stand's attack.
Avdol reveals that the Stand is High Priestess used by Midler, and is a long range Stand that can turn into anything as long as it's made of a mineral.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_180.out: The group flees to the other end of the submarine, while Jotaro proclaims that he will personally destroy the enemy.
Avdol explains that they have to escape from the submarine, and the group begins equipping scuba gear.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_181.des: As the group dons their scuba gear Joseph teaches them the basics of diving. He explains that they must not panic, and that they must slowly rise to the surface, explaining that if they rise too quickly their lungs and blood vessels will burst. Joseph then tells them they'll have to use hand signals because they can't talk underwater which prompts Avdol to remind him they can talk with their Stands.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_181.int: As the group dons their scuba gear Joseph teaches them the basics of diving.
He explains that they must not panic, and that they must slowly rise to the surface, explaining that if they rise too quickly their lungs and blood vessels will burst.
Joseph then tells them they'll have to use hand signals because they can't talk underwater which prompts Avdol to remind him they can talk with their Stands.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_181.out: The group swims up along the coastal floor and spots a pair of sea tunnels.
They swim towards the tunnels, however these aren't tunnels but the giant nostrils of High Priestess embedded in the sea floor.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_182.des: On the sea floor, the group gets sucked into High Priestess's giant mouth. As they get trapped in the Stand's mouth Midler mocks them, stating that she is close by on the seashore. The group stands within the Stand's mouth, and Midler says that Jotaro is her type making it hard for her to kill him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_182.int: On the sea floor, the group gets sucked into High Priestess's giant mouth.
As they get trapped in the Stand's mouth Midler mocks them, stating that she is close by on the seashore.
The group stands within the Stand's mouth, and Midler says that Jotaro is her type making it hard for her to kill him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_182.out: Polnareff goes to inspect the body but regrets doing so immediately, as her face took quite the beating from Star Platinum.
The group, finally in Egypt, reminisce over their long and hard journey and prepare for their fight to stop DIO and save Holy.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_183.des: After finally arriving in Egypt, the group travels through the Egyptian desert on their way to Cairo. They then wait for a helicopter from the Speedwagon Foundation whose crew is due to drop off a new Stand user who will accompany them. Joseph states that the Stand user has personality issues, and that that is why it took so long for him to join the others.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_183.int: After finally arriving in Egypt, the group travels through the Egyptian desert on their way to Cairo.
They then wait for a helicopter from the Speedwagon Foundation whose crew is due to drop off a new Stand user who will accompany them.
Joseph states that the Stand user has personality issues, and that that is why it took so long for him to join the others.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_183.out: Iggy steals the box from Avdol and begins chewing.
As he does this he smells the presence of another in the distance, watching, or rather hearing.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_183.tra: Head out: "The Fool" Iggy and "Geb" N'Doul, Part 1
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_184.des: The Speedwagon employees drop off some supplies for the group before they depart. Joseph asks them how his daughter is holding up, with which they, unfortunately, reply that her condition is getting worse. The Joestar group now has only two weeks to defeat DIO before Holy dies.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_184.int: The Speedwagon employees drop off some supplies for the group before they depart.
Joseph asks them how his daughter is holding up, with which they, unfortunately, reply that her condition is getting worse.
The Joestar group now has only two weeks to defeat DIO before Holy dies.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_184.out: He exclaims however that the water is what attacked them.
As he does this, the water from the canteen rushes out in the form of a hand and pulls his entire head into the canteen.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_184.tra: Head out: "The Fool" Iggy and "Geb" N'Doul, Part 2
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_185.des: The group jumps back as they watch the Speedwagon Foundation employees' head get pulled into the canteen. Using binoculars, Jotaro looks for the user, but he does not spot him. Kakyoin orders Polnareff to attack the canteen with Silver Chariot.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_185.int: The group jumps back as they watch the Speedwagon Foundation employees' head get pulled into the canteen.
Using binoculars, Jotaro looks for the user, but he does not spot him.
Kakyoin orders Polnareff to attack the canteen with Silver Chariot.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_185.out: Iggy, who is within the vehicle, foresees Geb's attack and jumps out of the car as it sinks within the sand.
This concerns N'Doul, as Iggy is the only one who can sense his presence, and therefore his greatest threat.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_185.tra: Head out: "The Fool" Iggy and "Geb" N'Doul, Part 3
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_186.des: After hearing Iggy avoid Geb's attack, N'Doul prepares to finish him off, as he feels that Iggy is his greatest threat. However, as the car the Joestar group is in sinks further into the sand, Iggy sits to the side and begins napping; not caring about the fates of his teammates. N'Doul realizes this and focuses his attack back onto the group.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_186.int: After hearing Iggy avoid Geb's attack, N'Doul prepares to finish him off, as he feels that Iggy is his greatest threat.
However, as the car the Joestar group is in sinks further into the sand, Iggy sits to the side and begins napping; not caring about the fates of his teammates.
N'Doul realizes this and focuses his attack back onto the group.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_186.out: Jotaro, realizing the power of Iggy's great sense of smell, grabs the dog and forces him into showing where the enemy is.
Iggy summons The Fool and uses it to fly away, but Jotaro grabs on and rides along with him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_186.tra: Go: "The Fool" Iggy and "Geb" N'Doul, Part 4
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_187.des: Jotaro hangs onto Iggy as they fly towards their adversary. As the two silently glide towards him N'Doul locates them and begins to panic. However, Jotaro and Iggy's combined weight is too much for The Fool and they begin descending closer and closer to the ground.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_187.int: Jotaro hangs onto Iggy as they fly towards their adversary.
As the two silently glide towards him N'Doul locates them and begins to panic.
However, Jotaro and Iggy's combined weight is too much for The Fool and they begin descending closer and closer to the ground.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_187.out: N'Doul and Iggy both summon their Stands and save themselves, but in the chaos, N'Doul loses track of Jotaro's location.
As N'Doul searches for Jotaro, Jotaro reveals that he is now standing right behind him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_187.tra: Go: "The Fool" Iggy and "Geb" N'Doul, Part 5
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_188.des: After losing track of Jotaro, N'Doul starts to panic, unknowing that his enemy is standing right behind him. After noticing the frightened sounds coming from Iggy, N'Doul surrounds himself with Geb, deducing that Jotaro is nearby. The two prepare for their standoff, and with their Stands suddenly attack one another.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_188.int: After losing track of Jotaro, N'Doul starts to panic, unknowing that his enemy is standing right behind him.
After noticing the frightened sounds coming from Iggy, N'Doul surrounds himself with Geb, deducing that Jotaro is nearby.
The two prepare for their standoff, and with their Stands suddenly attack one another.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_188.out: As he does this Iggy angrily walks away, returning with Jotaro's hat in his mouth.
The dog returns the hat that was knocked off during the fight, along with a little present stuck to the rim.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_188.tra: Go: "The Fool" Iggy and "Geb" N'Doul, Part 6
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_189.des: In the Nubia region of Egypt, in Abu Simbel, a strange looking boy named Boingo sits and reads a comic book. Boingo is approached by an older kid, who asks if he could see his comic book as he is an aspiring comic artist and enjoys reading strange comics. Boingo gives him the book, and the kid begins reading.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_189.int: In the Nubia region of Egypt, in Abu Simbel, a strange looking boy named Boingo sits and reads a comic book.
Boingo is approached by an older kid, who asks if he could see his comic book as he is an aspiring comic artist and enjoys reading strange comics.
Boingo gives him the book, and the kid begins reading.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_189.out: The comic states that in Aswan Oingo and Boingo will find Jotaro, Polnareff, and Joseph, and they will drink tea that Oingo poisoned.
With Boingo's Tohth and Oingo's Khnum, the two brothers are invincible.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_189.tra: Head out: "Khnum" Oingo and "Tohth" Boingo, Part 1
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_190.des: After reading Tohth's prophecy, Oingo and Boingo find a cafe and take out the staff so that they can poison the Joestar group's drinks. Jotaro, Joseph, and Polnareff enter the cafe, forced to wait in the city until Avdol's recovery. Oingo, pretending to be a waiter, approaches the three and asks for their order.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_190.int: After reading Tohth's prophecy, Oingo and Boingo find a cafe and take out the staff so that they can poison the Joestar group's drinks.
Jotaro, Joseph, and Polnareff enter the cafe, forced to wait in the city until Avdol's recovery.
Oingo, pretending to be a waiter, approaches the three and asks for their order.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_190.out: Despite not having done anything wrong, Oingo beats the man up and takes his wallet.
Finally, the next prophecy arrives, foretelling that Oingo will put a bomb disguised as an orange in the Joestar group's car, and it will detonate causing Jotaro's face to split in two.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_190.tra: Head out: "Khnum" Oingo and "Tohth" Boingo, Part 2
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_191.des: Oingo approaches the Joestar group's car so that he can place a bomb hidden within an orange in it that when detonated will split Jotaro's face in half, as foretold by Tohth's prophecy. Oingo enters the car to place the orange, but Joseph and Polnareff spot him. However, by using Khnum, Oingo is able to disguise himself as Jotaro.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_191.int: Oingo approaches the Joestar group's car so that he can place a bomb hidden within an orange in it that when detonated will split Jotaro's face in half, as foretold by Tohth's prophecy.
Oingo enters the car to place the orange, but Joseph and Polnareff spot him.
However, by using Khnum, Oingo is able to disguise himself as Jotaro.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_191.out: He manages to pull it off, but when asked to drink some juice at the same time he completely fails.
With fate against him, Oingo believes he has no chance of surviving this encounter.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_191.tra: Head out: "Khnum" Oingo and "Tohth" Boingo, Part 3
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_192.des: In the car, Oingo begins panicking as he feels that Polnareff and Joseph are becoming suspicious of him. Also if he continues to disguise himself as Jotaro then Tohth's prophecy will come true and his face will split in half when the orange bomb explodes. However, if he undoes his disguise then Polnareff and Joseph will kill him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_192.int: In the car, Oingo begins panicking as he feels that Polnareff and Joseph are becoming suspicious of him.
Also if he continues to disguise himself as Jotaro then Tohth's prophecy will come true and his face will split in half when the orange bomb explodes.
However, if he undoes his disguise then Polnareff and Joseph will kill him.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_192.out: Knowing that his shy little brother has finally grown up, Oingo can now rest in peace.
However, fate is not so kind, as the innocent man Oingo beat up earlier has returned with his huge musc
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_192.tra: Head out: "Khnum" Oingo and "Tohth" Boingo, Part 4
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_193.des: In the hospital in Aswan, Kakyoin tells the group that his treatment is going well and that because his pupils remained unscathed that he'll be able to see again within a few days. When he regains his sight Kakyoin will rejoin the group, but until then they continue their journey to Cairo to find DIO. Meanwhile, along the Nile's coast, a group of farmers stumble upon a scimitar lying on the ground.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_193.int: In the hospital in Aswan, Kakyoin tells the group that his treatment is going well and that because his pupils remained unscathed that he'll be able to see again within a few days.
When he regains his sight Kakyoin will rejoin the group, but until then they continue their journey to Cairo to find DIO.
Meanwhile, along the Nile's coast, a group of farmers stumble upon a scimitar lying on the ground.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_193.out: Chaka grabs the sword and succumbs to the power of Anubis.
In fear the last farmer hides behind their cow, as Chaka slices through the cow, killing the man but leaving the cow perfectly intact.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_194.des: While in Kom Ombo, Polnareff gets separated from the rest of the group. He walks to a temple as he looks for his friends and notices someone following him in plain sight. Polnareff commends him for his bravery in attacking him directly.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_194.int: While in Kom Ombo, Polnareff gets separated from the rest of the group.
He walks to a temple as he looks for his friends and notices someone following him in plain sight.
Polnareff commends him for his bravery in attacking him directly.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_194.out: Polnareff notices the sword, now sheathed, lying next to Chaka.
He picks it up and begins to unsheathe it.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_195.des: Polnareff begins unsheathing Anubis and almost succumbs to its will, however, Jotaro and the others find him and he quickly returns the sword to its sheath. Polnareff confidently tells them about his fight with Chaka. Polnareff tries to pick up the sword but notices that a group of mice is carrying it away.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_195.int: Polnareff begins unsheathing Anubis and almost succumbs to its will, however, Jotaro and the others find him and he quickly returns the sword to its sheath.
Polnareff confidently tells them about his fight with Chaka.
Polnareff tries to pick up the sword but notices that a group of mice is carrying it away.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_195.out: Polnareff realizes that the sword itself is the Stand and that it is possessing the barber.
Silver Chariot tries to block Anubis's strike, but Anubis overpowers him stating that he cannot lose to the same opponent twice.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_196.des: Jotaro awakens to see the barber attacking Polnareff with a sword. Polnareff explains to Jotaro that the sword is a Stand, and that it is possessing the barber. Polnareff uses Silver Chariot to attack with all his might, but Anubis knows all about Silver Chariot's abilities and limitations.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_196.int: Jotaro awakens to see the barber attacking Polnareff with a sword.
Polnareff explains to Jotaro that the sword is a Stand, and that it is possessing the barber.
Polnareff uses Silver Chariot to attack with all his might, but Anubis knows all about Silver Chariot's abilities and limitations.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_196.out: However, a policeman spots Polnareff and grabs the sword from him, thinking he is partaking in illegal activities.
The two tug at the sword until Polnareff accidentally unsheathes it.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_197.des: With Anubis unsheathed, Polnareff is now fully under its control. His first act is to punish the police officer who had unfortunately interfered. Jotaro quickly kicks the officer out of Polnareff's way and prepares for their fight.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_197.int: With Anubis unsheathed, Polnareff is now fully under its control.
His first act is to punish the police officer who had unfortunately interfered.
Jotaro quickly kicks the officer out of Polnareff's way and prepares for their fight.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_197.out: Star Platinum and Anubis+Chariot face off in a flurry of punches and dancing blades, but the deadly combo is too powerful and manage to stab Jotaro in the abdomen.
Anubis gloats as it has finally defeated the invincible Stand warrior.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_198.des: Under Anubis's control, Silver Chariot inserts its blade further into Jotaro's abdomen. Star Platinum grabs the blade, but Anubis has already memorized Star Platinum's strength making the Stand's efforts fruitless. Jotaro warns Anubis to stop, but Anubis confidently inserts his blade further.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_198.int: Under Anubis's control, Silver Chariot inserts its blade further into Jotaro's abdomen.
Star Platinum grabs the blade, but Anubis has already memorized Star Platinum's strength making the Stand's efforts fruitless.
Jotaro warns Anubis to stop, but Anubis confidently inserts his blade further.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_198.out: Anubis sinks to the bottom of the Nile, unable to move or even drown.
The Stand is forced to sit and rust at the bottom of the river until the end of days.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_199.des: The Joestar group continues their journey to Cairo in order to stop DIO and rescue Holy from her curse. They take a quick stop in Luxor, where Joseph decides to use the restroom. However, he quickly decides not to when he realizes how primitive it is.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_199.int: The Joestar group continues their journey to Cairo in order to stop DIO and rescue Holy from her curse.
They take a quick stop in Luxor, where Joseph decides to use the restroom.
However, he quickly decides not to when he realizes how primitive it is.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_199.out: The man loses his grip and the hammer goes flying towards Joseph, but Avdol catches it.
Not realizing what happened, the group assumes the man threw his hammer in frustration after possibly hammering his finger, so they think nothing of it and continue toward a hotel.
lang.quest.jojorpg.stardust_crusaders_200.des: In a hotel room, Avdol wakes up Joseph as the group prepares to go eat breakfast. Polnareff yells at Joseph as old men are supposed to wake up early. intro.fallback: In the year 1988, 17-year-old delinquent Jotaro Kujo, grandson of Joseph Joestar, and son of Holy Kujo, is temporarily detained after beating up three armed men and a trained boxer.

His prison mates confirm this bizarre claim, desperate to get out of the shared cell, seemingly fearing this 'evil demon'.
